official_definition: Ultimate Energy (Your Attack Step) "Incarnate"/"Next Generation" family Ultimates other than this card and copies of it gain an extra Red symbol.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Ultimate Energy] or [Ultimate Energy: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Ultimate Energy]", "give [Ultimate Energy]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
